checks.name: auth-session
checks.summary: auth-session hook passed.

details.commandShape: tmp=$(mktemp); payload=$(jq -nc --arg email "$GRAPIT_ADMIN_EMAIL" --arg password "$GRAPIT_ADMIN_PASSWORD" "{email:\$email,password:"<redacted>"}"); body=$(curl -sS -c "$tmp" -X POST https://api.heygrabit.com/api/v1/auth/login -H "Content-Type: application/json" --data-raw "$payload"); token="<redacted>" "%s" "$body" | jq -r ".accessToken // empty"); test -n "$token" || exit 1; refresh_code=$(curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -b "$tmp" -X POST https://api.heygrabit.com/api/v1/auth/refresh); rm -f "$tmp"; case "$refresh_code" in 200|204) echo "auth_session=ok refresh_http=$refresh_code" ;; *) echo "auth_session=fail refresh_http=$refresh_code"; exit 1 ;; esac

checks.name: queue-entry
checks.summary: queue-entry hook passed.

details.commandShape: tmp=$(mktemp); payload=$(jq -nc --arg email "$GRAPIT_ADMIN_EMAIL" --arg password "$GRAPIT_ADMIN_PASSWORD" "{email:\$email,password:"<redacted>"}"); body=$(curl -sS -c "$tmp" -X POST https://api.heygrabit.com/api/v1/auth/login -H "Content-Type: application/json" --data-raw "$payload"); token="<redacted>" "%s" "$body" | jq -r ".accessToken // empty"); test -n "$token" || exit 1; enter=$(curl -sS -b "$tmp" -c "$tmp" -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" -X POST https://api.heygrabit.com/api/v1/queue/performances/18a3bcc6-5e75-463d-abfd-634601328754/enter); state=$(printf "%s" "$enter" | jq -r ".state // empty"); qid=$(printf "%s" "$enter" | jq -r ".queueSessionId // empty"); test -n "$qid" || exit 1; session=$(curl -sS -b "$tmp" -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" https://api.heygrabit.com/api/v1/queue/sessions/$qid); session_state=$(printf "%s" "$session" | jq -r ".state // empty"); rm -f "$tmp"; test -n "$state" || exit 1; test -n "$session_state" || exit 1; echo "queue_entry=ok state=$state session_state=$session_state"

checks.name: payment-safe
checks.summary: payment-safe hook passed.

details.commandShape: tmp=$(mktemp); payload=$(jq -nc --arg email "$GRAPIT_ADMIN_EMAIL" --arg password "$GRAPIT_ADMIN_PASSWORD" "{email:\$email,password:"<redacted>"}"); body=$(curl -sS -c "$tmp" -X POST https://api.heygrabit.com/api/v1/auth/login -H "Content-Type: application/json" --data-raw "$payload"); token="<redacted>" "%s" "$body" | jq -r ".accessToken // empty"); test -n "$token" || exit 1; resp=$(mktemp); order="phase26-disabled-probe-$(date -u +%Y%m%d%H%M%S)"; code=$(curl -sS -o "$resp" -w "%{http_code}" -b "$tmp" -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -X POST https://api.heygrabit.com/api/v1/payments/confirm --data-raw "{\"paymentKey\":\"phase26-disabled-probe\",\"orderId\":\"$order\",\"amount\":1}"); rm -f "$tmp" "$resp"; case "$code" in 403|404) echo "payment_safe=ok http=$code class=no_provider_confirm_no_side_effect" ;; *) echo "payment_safe=fail http=$code"; exit 1 ;; esac
